Chapter 6173: Don’T Be Pretentious In My Presence

Chapter 6173: Don’t Be Pretentious In My Presence

The suppressive move turned out to be utterly useless before Li Qiye. His palm carried his unstoppable will, easily crushing the resistance.

“Crack!” Immortal Suppressor’s hands shattered along with his lotus throne.

As he was still stunned by the unfavorable exchange, Li Qiye caught his ankle and smashed him against the stars.

One star shattered after another before Li Qiye tossed him into space, painting it red with his blood.

Everyone became stiff like wooden chickens, whether it be the weak or the strong such as Chu Zhu.

Immortal Suppressor had slayed countless emperors and desolate gods. He had a primal anima long ago and had progressed in this realm. Rumor has it only an overlord or above could defeat him.

However, Li Qiye toyed with him like a punching bag, causing spatial cracks to appear.

“Don’t be pretentious in my presence.” Li Qiye patted his palms and smiled.

This line has been said by many but it sounded different from Li Qiye. If others were to use it, they would sound weak and laughable like a monkey wearing a scholar’s cap. It became taboo; only Li Qiye was qualified to use it.

“Bang!” Immortal Suppressor escaped fragmented space. He was covered in blood with one arm severed and the other shattered.

Nevertheless, he activated his dao and the primal anima washed away the blood. His hands healed and returned to their original state.

Although he looked the same as before, his reputation was tainted. The number one spot in Sin belonged to him no longer.

“This is insane.” Spectators turned pale.

“Can… he not be a primal ancestor?” An apex emperor felt his knees trembling.

A while ago, many speculated Li Qiye’s true cultivation. Putting the enigmatic nature of his mortal self aside, they thought he was a primal ancestor.

Now, they couldn’t help reevaluating this assessment. After all, Immortal Suppressor might have reached the peak of this realm. How could he be so helpless?

“So strong.” Immortal Suppressor got up and staggered backward, frightened.

Despite seemingly not being in a defensive stance, his seating position was perfect and left an indelible impression. The great Transcendent Emperor didn’t wow the crowd as much as he did.

Now, everything seemed meaningless against Li Qiye. The supreme Immortal Suppressor looked pitiful like a weak mortal. Either way, the greatest existence still resembled an insect before Li Qiye.

People felt despair after thinking it through. Effort and cultivation were meaningless since even primal ancestors were unqualified to face him.

“Your cultivation isn’t too bad. I don’t want to kill you before you display the fruits of your lifelong effort.” Li Qiye said: “Come, this is your chance, a whole life of training for a moment of brilliance.”

The crowd was speechless since he spoke as if he was being merciful, letting the opponent have a chance to fight. Otherwise, he could crush them with a single move, not allowing them to display their worth. That death would be no different from a mortal’s demise then.

His mercy was still overbearing, causing Immortal Suppressor to gaze at him. However, he seemed like a giant compared to everyone else.

Their words couldn’t reach him, akin to ants being unable to communicate with a god.
